d: Israel is voting in an election that could determine Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s political future and the country’s direction after years of conflict. Netanyahu has framed the vote as an “emergency”, urging right-wing voters to turn out and leaning heavily on his security credentials and repeated endorsements from US President Donald Trump. Reports also say Netanyahu had pushed for a fresh strike on Iran before the election, though Israel’s military chief objected.
